profile: CAMP4 Therapeutics develops RNA-targeting therapeutics intended to increase gene expression and restore protein levels in genetic diseases. Its lead candidate, CMP-002, is an antisense oligonucleotide designed to increase SYNGAP1 expression and is in preclinical development for SYNGAP1-related disorder. The company uses its RAP Platform to identify regulatory RNAs and generate candidates, focusing on central nervous system diseases and additional discovery programs.
